passages.provision_quote: A firearm industry member shall not advertise, market, or arrange for placement of an advertising or marketing communication concerning any firearm-related product in a manner that is designed, intended, or reasonably appears to be attractive to minors.
passages.note: An advertising-and-marketing restriction on firearm industry members; it does not say which firearms civilians may own, buy or carry (annex hard case: marketing/advertising rules are adjacent).

rows.reasoning: The only source is AB 2571 (2021-2022), which she authored; its operative section bars a firearm industry member from marketing a firearm-related product in a manner "attractive to minors" and imposes a civil penalty. That regulates advertising, not which firearms may be owned, bought or carried, so it reaches neither "Ban semi-automatic assault-style weapons, while allowing other firearms" nor "Allow all types of firearms, but require universal background checks on every sale"; no passage survives V2.
